summary: Friend Tow is a cozy physics-puzzle fishing game where you slide a little boat, swing a pendulum hook, and tow a wobbly chain of jellyfish, octopuses, and a very heavy whale back to the dock aquarium before sunset. Play with Left/Right or A/D to move, hold and release Space to lower and reel the hook, fill all 8 aquarium spots in 90 seconds, watch for Perfect Drops in the lighthouse beam, and avoid hard bonks on rocks that shake friends loose.
